_about: Curated nicknames and abbreviations that Zambian media use for public figures, which Wikidata often lacks. Matched by the person's full name (as on Wikidata/Wikipedia) when the person is first added. Short forms are always treated as ambiguous: they are only hyperlinked when the article is about Zambia or also names the person in full. Add entries here or through POST /api/admin/people/<id>/aliases.
